title: peramium nantoense
intro: Peramium nantoense, commonly known as Peramium, is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Peramium nantoense include its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a subject of interest in the field of traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents present in Peramium include alkaloids and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
